review_type: Finite independent code-versus-plan read-through; no production edits or additional model execution

items.finding: restore loads v24 invocation to locate prepared, constructs the full mean interface, then strictly loads the corresponding saved mean initial.pt before converting it. JointSender deep-copies encoder, embedding, LSTM, fusion and output. Receiver and frozen agent weights are retained from that loaded state.

The original bilinear module is absent from the new sender. Its position in the parameter enumeration is occupied by a bias-free96x96 zero-initialized contrast matrix, created within a fork_rng. m uses keys.mean; d is half the ordered difference. Contrast is added before the original tanh, consistent with the plan. Both tokens remain learned rather than resource-routed.

items.area: Old-only exposure and no private inference
items.finding: Every update requests world.fixture(...,old,social,train_worlds), then indexes the frozen concepts with those indices. train/test concepts are loaded directly from the bound v24 .npy caches; no private-head, temporal encoder or DINO forward is invoked by the new fit. All30 cache availability is not social all30 training exposure.

The same seed/partition/person/step fixture and four independent uniform columns drive token and food/water action sampling. Receiver obtains only detached integer messages through the original receiving interface. Correct positions are used after action sampling to form reward; there is no CE, oracle concept substitution or differentiable cross-agent communication.

R=.25*(food+water)+.5*both, baseline.5, two-token/two-action summed policy and entropy terms, per-person role average/2, fresh Adam.0007, sender/receiver clipping2, entropy.02 for2100 then0 match the fixed plan. Formal defaults are four sources x three partitions x one joint arm x2400, with512messages/1024actions per pair update.

contrast_gradient_norm_before_clip is computed after backward on the role-averaged loss and before either clip call. It is therefore the already role-weighted contrast gradient norm, not the gradient of the unweighted sender loss. All sender and receiver norms are recorded, and frozen parameter gradients are asserted absent.

Invocation explicitly identifies old18 held-out-photo greedy joint-minus-prior-mean as the primary. social_eval preserves complete960-world protocols and the original all-group social metrics, including new12 and both masks, at all fixed checkpoints. Training does not select sources, checkpoints or budget by either primary or auxiliary outcomes. Final source-level contrast aggregation remains the separate analyzer responsibility.

Input manifest binds the v24 mean initial states, concepts, worlds, prior analysis/audit and complete formal manifest, plus consumed prepared files. Source/input hashes are rechecked at completion; frozen agent states are checked against their initial fingerprints. The planned independent execution audit, not this manual review, establishes numerical replay and all-step equivalence.

limitations: Initial mathematical equivalence was inspected;1920-world exact equality belongs to the separately recorded production self-test and independent audit.
No new model calls, training, cache inference or formal outcome analysis were performed in this review.
Same stored parameter count is not equal effective capacity; the new contrast has a task gradient and can change clipping and subsequent trajectories.
